notes: Data is the brand's Nutritionix Interactive Nutrition Menu (premium grid), which blazepizza.com ("Nutrition Calculator") links/embeds as its official nutrition menu. Serving = one menu item as listed. Build-your-own components (dough, sauce, cheese, meats & veggies, finishes) are listed for the pizza size named in parentheses exactly as the calculator grid presents them (the grid does not state the portion basis; values match a per-slice basis for the plain dough); sum them for a custom pizza. Atwater outliers (>20%, left as published): Milk (1 serving): 110 cal vs 147 Atwater; Bottled Beer (1 serving): 150 cal vs 60 Atwater; Red Wine (1 serving): 160 cal vs 20 Atwater; White Wine (1 serving): 150 cal vs 20 Atwater
